name: Hermes zero-preserving quantile (experimental)
description: Maps positive counts toward a within-library mean empirical quantile function, averaging tied rank targets and preserving every zero. Ties take the average of their rank targets rather than a dense rank.
formula: Q_group(p) = mean_j Q_positive,j(p); map positive ranks to Q_group; average targets within tied counts; retain zeros
may_suit: Experimental sensitivity comparison when positive-count distribution matching is scientifically justified.
caution: Nonlinear; may erase real abundance/composition differences. Unequal occupied-site counts and ties prevent exact full-distribution matching. Not a physical abundance estimate or a default method.
